inputs.prompt: Replace the blank gray canvas in <image1> with the following complete character image. Use the other images only as references, not as a collage. Render an opaque image. Photorealistic studio character reference. Exactly one person, plain neutral light gray background, soft even light, realistic skin and fabric. No text, no panels, no props unless part of the outfit. Entire body including head and both shoes, centered, 6 percent margin above and below, relaxed upright neutral stance, arms slightly away from torso, hands empty. Eye-level camera, natural long-lens perspective, no foreshortening. <image2> is the only source for this person's facial identity. Preserve the head shape, forehead, eyebrows, eye shape and spacing, nose, mouth, skin tone, apparent age and visible hairline; ignore the clothing and background in <image2>. <image3> is the clothing source. If several people appear in <image3>, use only the central wearer. Study the complete outfit carefully: headwear, scarf and knot, collar, garment cut and fabric, fastenings, chest and sleeve patch positions, pockets, trouser shape and footwear. Transfer each visible item to the same anatomical location on the person from <image2>, with realistic fabric fit and no mirrored or duplicated badges. Ignore the outfit wearer's face, sunglasses, pose and background. If <image3> has a beret, reproduce its color, soft crown, tilt, side drape, band and front insignia. Fit it snugly to the head from <image2>: the lower edge of the band sits just a few millimeters above the tops of both eyebrows, leaving only a thin strip of forehead while the eyebrows and eyes stay fully visible. Do not perch the beret high or pull it over the eyebrows. Arrange the original hair naturally under and beside the band. For other headwear, use the same realistic fit and preserve its reference shape. Straight front view facing the camera. The scarf knot and hanging tails stay on the chest, with front patches only on the front. If footwear is unseen use simple matching shoes. Preserve natural facial detail. Avoid: multiple people, duplicate person, collage, text, watermark, cropped feet, cropped head, extra limbs, deformed hands, different clothes, different identity, fisheye.

The rear garment shows continuous fabric and plausible rear seams. Strict 180-degree rear view, looking directly away, back of head visible, no face visible. Infer unseen rear garment construction conservatively; do not duplicate front decorations. Match the head-to-foot size of <image2>.
